different D0 partial hours and dates

predeclared_readout.rule: for a mature normal-status same-window record with complete additive counts: report scale above/below reference and follow-density above/below reference as a two-axis descriptive readout; both above offers preliminary support, both below reduces support only when distribution and execution are interpretable, mixed remains mixed. Fewer than 5 follow events marks density low-event/unstable regardless of apparent ratio. No statistical superiority or causal win claim
predeclared_readout.sample_bias: reference includes eventual-normal >=100 selected historical notes; not random/all-account expectation; publication hours and versions differ

metrics: D0 views/impressions/follow events and remaining hours
1000 * same-window follow events / views; not unique-user conversion
same-cutoff entry shares and denominator if available; never divide unmatched follow-source and view-source windows
same-cutoff 2/5/15/30-second retention and contemporaneous platform reference; beyond length or unavailable fields NA
anonymous actual-comment themes if separately authorized
future_observation.comments_sampling: future separate authorization only: all available comments if <=20, otherwise first 20 chronological; no private names or raw comment bundle; distinguish practical question, reliability, cost, misunderstanding, repeat-interest, emotion/unrelated. >=2 independent unsolicited repeat-interest comments is a qualitative clue only, not population demand
missing_or_confounded: restricted/immature/missing dates or mismatched cutoffs => evidence_insufficient for relevant inference
promotion changes => stratify; do not compare as natural
no original version link => execution/topic attribution unknown
no retention/source fields => NA, no zero fill
material/permission gate failure => production feasibility failure, not market-demand failure

immutability: after freeze commit, explanations/results go in new files or append-only new commits; do not rewrite this JSON or frozen Markdown
